name: Update Microsoft Defender signatures (Windows)
description: Asks Defender to update its antimalware signatures with Update-MpSignature. Dry run by default.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When enabled, nothing is changed and the script only prints what it would do.

output: [DRY-RUN] or [DONE]/[SKIP] lines with signature version before and after. Exit 0; exit 1 if the update failed.
